subject.title: fix(slack): prefer native status by default

question: Should unset Slack status reactions be suppressed only when native assistant status has a usable thread target, or should default top-level Slack messages intentionally fall back to a static acknowledgement only?
rationale: Source inspection shows the fallback regression, but accepting static-only progress for existing unthreaded Slack paths is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
options.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually show it.

options.title: Accept Static Ack Default
options.body: Merge the stricter default only if maintainers intentionally accept losing lifecycle progress reactions for unthreaded Slack paths and document that behavior.

options.title: Pause For Slack Progress Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide the broader Slack native-status, loading-message, and reaction-progress UX policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually show it.
